lines.t: Verse 1
All the pressure, all the anxiety, the noise so loud
Feels like I’m sinking until You lift me out
Every burden heavier than I can hold
But You reach for me when I start to fold
Pre-Chorus
The noise is loud, but I’m not going down, down, down
I’m rising up above the sound, sound, sound
Chorus
Your liftin' me high above the noise, oh-oh
I can finally breathe again, oh-oh.
All the pressure, all the anxiety was pulling me under
But You pull me out like I’m breaking through the thunder
Lord, You’re helping me through the fight,
You’re lifting me out of the noise in this night
Verse 2
Every echo tries to steal my peace
But something deeper is alive in me
When everything is spinning out of place
I hear Your voice cutting through the space
Pre-Chorus
The noise is loud, but I’m not going down, down, down
I’m rising up above the sound, sound, sound
Chorus
Your liftin' me high above the noise, oh-oh
I can finally breathe again, oh-oh.
All the pressure, all the anxiety was pulling me under
But You pull me out like I’m breaking through the thunder
Lord, You’re helping me through the fight,
You’re lifting me out of the noise in this night
Bridge
I was drowning in the static, lost inside the storm
But there’s a light breaking through the dark and worn
And I don’t have to understand it all to know it’s real
Something higher is the reason I can finally heal
Final Chorus
Your liftin' me high above the noise, oh-oh
I can finally breathe again, oh-oh.

You’re lifting me out of the noise in this night
